description.value: Summit Sport Whistler bills itself as Whistler's largest bike, ski, and board shop, operating year-round with a seasonal swing between snow sports and mountain biking. The shop offers both sales and full bike service, positioning itself as a one-stop destination in a world-class ride destination. A touring cyclist arriving in Whistler needing a tune-up or repair would find a dedicated service operation here.
